Peripheral Nerve Disorders

Your peripheral nerves connect your brain and spinal cord to the rest of your body. Damage can cause numbness, tingling feet, and pain.

Treatment

Treatment depends on the cause. Managing diabetes can help prevent nerve damage. Medicines may relieve nerve pain. There is no cure that reverses all nerve damage, so beware of products that promise one.
